ns2:section.sectionText: Students in this class will prepare for, attend, and reflect on portions of following online Financial Planning conferences: Morningstar MCIUS – See the Future of Investing. September 16 & 17 https://www.morningstar.com/en-us/events/mic Illinois FPA CAP Conference – September 24 & 25 https://www.fpaillinois.org/events/EventDetails.aspx?id=1316525&group= National Financial Planning Association Conference - September 30 – October 2 - https://fpaannual.org/ Financial Planning Spectacular – October 23 (site being constructed) Diversitas Financial Planning Summit – October 27 https://www.uakron.edu/cba/diversitas/ Students are required to attend live/online when possible and watch archived sessions when not. Each conference will have a deep assessment with a grading rubric. Prereq: Completion of or concurrent registration in ACE 240 or equivalent.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
